prompt: Add a template function `chunk` to the collections namespace. `{{ chunk 2 (slice 1 2 3 4 5) }}` returns `[[1 2] [3 4] [5]]`: the list split into consecutive chunks of the given size, the last one shorter when the length is not a multiple. Go signature, in package tpl/collections: `func (ns *Namespace) Chunk(size any, l any) ([][]any, error)`. size must be a positive integer, otherwise return an error; l may be a slice or an array, and any other kind (including nil) returns an error. An empty list gives an empty result. Register it in the namespace's template function mapping with an example, and add tests. Keep the existing tests passing.
